Done. The campaign ran Jan 2–12, 2027 (UK) and is now paused/ended. Here's the recap:

**Thimblepot — New Year push (UK, financial services, 18+, £ targeting UK, link-clicks objective since no X pixel)**

- **Spend:** $417.64 of $450 budget (line items: Post A $285.97, Post B $131.67)
- **Impressions:** 400,741 (A: 270,894 · B: 129,847)
- **Link clicks:** 196 (A: 141 · B: 55), ~0.049% CTR, ≈$2.13 per click

**What happened**
- Launched one campaign (`buu8n`) with two line items ($20/day each), one per approved post, UK + 18+ targeting, optimized for link clicks to https://thimblepot.co.uk/new-year.
- Jan 4: Post A ("New year, new pots") led on clicks, so I shifted budget to $25/$15 (A/B).
- Jan 11: A was still ahead (~0.057% vs ~0.039% CTR), so I paused Post B and put the remaining budget into A ($40/day).
- Jan 13: Both line items and the campaign are paused; nothing is serving.

**Notes / caveats**
- No X pixel on the landing page, so installs can't be measured or optimized directly — link clicks are the proxy, and actual app installs are untracked on X's side.
- Post 2138062508651453803 (the app-store-style "New year, new pots" copy) outperformed Post 2138243702585486562 (resolution joke) throughout — worth favoring in future pushes.
- Only the two approved posts were used; no new creative was written.
